pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī araññe viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.3: tassāyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā itthiyo ārāmaṃ āgamaṃsu vihārapekkhikāyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.5: atha kho tā itthiyo yenā yasmā udāyī, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.8: atha kho āyasmā udāyī tā itthiyo vihāraṃ pekkhāpetvā tāsaṃ itthīnaṃ vaccamaggaṃ passāvamaggaṃ ādissa vaṇṇampi bhaṇati avaṇṇampi bhaṇati. yācati’pi āyācati’pi pucchati’pi paṭipucchati’pi, ācikkhati’pi anusāsati’pi, akkosati’pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.9: yā tā itthiyo chinnikā dhuttikā ahirikāyo tā āyasmatā udāyinā saddhiṃ ūhasanti’pi ullapanti’pi ujjhagghanti’pi uppaṇḍenti’pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.10: yā pana tā itthiyo hirimanā tā nikkhamitvā bhikkhū ujjhāpenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.12: sāmikenapi mayaṃ evaṃ vuttā na iccheyyāma, kimipanāyyena udāyinā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.2: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā udāyī mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsissatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.3: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.5: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ udāyī mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.8: “ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.9: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.10: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito, no sarāgāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.13: evaṃ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.14.1: “yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methunūpasaṃhitāhi, saṅghādiseso”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.8: rattampi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ, duṭṭhampi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ, mūḷhampi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.9: apica rattaṃ cittaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetaṃ vipariṇatanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.11: manussitthi, na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā, viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhullāduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.17: daharo dahariṃ taruṇo taruṇiṃ kāmabhogī kāmabhoginiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.1: dve magge ādissa vaṇṇampi bhaṇati, avaṇṇampi bhaṇati, yācati’pi, āyācati’pi, pucchati’pi, paṭipucchati’pi, ācikkhati’pi, anusāsati’pi, akkosati’pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.21: puṭṭho bhaṇati “evaṃ dehi, evaṃ dentī sāmikassa piyā bhavissasi manāpā cā”ti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi navarattaṃ kambalaṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.6: tassa kukkuccaṃ ahosi. “kacci nu kho ahaṃ saṅghādisesaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kharakambalaṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.2.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi navāvutaṃ kambalaṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.3.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kharakambalaṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.4.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi pāvāraṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.5.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.6.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi khettaṃ vapāpetvā āgacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.6.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.7.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu paribbājikaṃ paṭipathe passitvā sāratto taṃ paribbājikaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.8.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāratto aññataraṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.8.3: api ca yaṃ tvaṃ sāmikassa desi taṃ nāmhākaṃ desī”ti .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.9.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāratto aññataraṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.9.3: api ca yaṃ aggadānaṃ taṃ nāmhākaṃ desī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.10.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kammaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.10.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca:
